description: This source file implements various subtitle processing functions, including quality check, subtitle generation, translation, validation, and a stub for writing processed subtitles. It is designed for integration with external speech-to-text engines and subtitle formatting libraries, providing testable logic for subtitle normalization and basic validation.

methods.description: Performs basic quality checks and normalization on a subtitle file, optionally simulating cue matching summary if a video path is provided, and enforces OTT line limits if specified.
